fusions.name: Pounding Gallop
fusions.desc: Charges in with a thundering run for 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at its full 7 tiles, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pawing Scrape
fusions.desc: Scrapes a hoof down the target for 4 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gate Break
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Cadence
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
